## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head 35c1e39643 · cards #37908 #37959 · area s2-ai · 2026-11-28T07:13Z

**L1 checklist** (no review face on this file list: this record is the review of record)
- **Shape and checks.** Every check on the head is green apart from expected skips; mergeable clean. The PR touches `AppAskPage.tsx`, `EmptyConversation.tsx`, `useChatConversation.ts`, `useConversationList.ts`, three tests, one string row group in all 11 locale packs, and a changeset. Not governed.
- **`?c=` check (#37908).** `fetchConversation` returns `null` only on 403 or 404 and throws on any other failure, so the page now reads `null` or another app's conversation as `foreign` and a throw as the new `failed` state. `failed` keeps `?c=` and offers Try again (back to `checking`) and New conversation. Only a definite answer drops `?c=`.
- **One history read (Premise corrected on #37908).** An `ours` verdict carries the check's record; `useChatConversation` takes it as `activeRecord` and spends it on the first resolve of that id only (a ref marks it spent; a record of another id is ignored), so opening `?c=` reads the history once. Another app's conversation is still read once and dropped; the PR's Acceptance notes say so.
- **No package.** An app without `_packageId` now shows a notice instead of a question box that could not start a conversation. Two CONTROL cases in `AppContent.aiChatEntryGate-37833.test.tsx`, whose fixture app has no `_packageId`, now assert the page itself; their route assertions are unchanged. Giving the fixture a package would move the app's route segment, so the thread did not, and said so in the PR body. Accepted.
- **Previews (#37959).** `useConversationList` takes `selectBackfillRows`; the page passes the rows it lists (at most five), so the home state reads at most five details, not up to twenty. Suggestions are keyed by position, so a repeated question draws twice without a key warning.
- **Tests.** Seven new tests sit in the existing shared test files (the AGENTS.md shared-harness rule, a deviation from the card's "new file" sentence that the PR notes). Reverting the source turns all seven red.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `Fixes #37908` and `Fixes #37959` are right.

Tier: S. Landing: ready and auto-merge in this stroke.
